label: Vercel and Supabase
about: What to look for in Vercel config and Supabase migrations, policies, functions and settings. Files only.
tested: One fixture of 16 planted risks (RLS and grants, policies, definer function and view, public buckets in SQL and config, service key in vercel.json and a cron call, verify_jwt off with no signature check, redirect URLs, CORS, rewrite, open redirect, cron): 16 of 16 found in one real-model run (18 items, 73 s, $0.25); an earlier, smaller fixture found 8 of 8 in its last run, 5 of 8 in two before. NOT verified: a real project, Vercel environment scopes (dashboard only), edge function code beyond a short stub, more than one fixture. Not reviewed by a Vercel or Supabase specialist.
